**PREFREEZE / no nominee.** [Report](/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/fresh-arithmetic-discovery-r103/REPORT.md)

Completed derivations cover a quadratic/cubic division-ring seed, exact-center identification, and normalized trace/norm transfer. Compatible source and classical operations pay these constructions; I did not identify a distinct substantial operation to nominate.

The sealed packet verifies: 64 payloads, 19 authenticated pinned blobs, seven artifact controls. All ten named stable originals remain unchanged. Reading limits, late evidence, initial erroneous excluded-tree filename traversal, and the externally changed parent ledger are disclosed. No excluded body was read. No reviews, count changes, or downstream work are requested.
